## Description

A hypermastigote flagellate (~150 µm) of the termite gut with thousands of flagella on its rostrum;
strictly anaerobic. It phagocytoses wood splinters through its posterior pole and ferments cellulose
for the termite.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `termite_gut` (weight 1); 12 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

An `obligate_symbiont` that appears only in the `termite_gut` biome; `anaerobe` and `posterior_mouth`.
The rostrum with the flagella is the narrow anterior pole.
